---
title: "Instacart Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

data("instacart")

set.seed(8105)

instacart_sample = instacart |>
  slice_sample(n = 10000)
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Products by Department (Bar Plot)

```{r}
department_counts = instacart_sample |>
  count(department)

bar_plot = department_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(department, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey60") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Department",
    y = "Number of Products"
  )

ggplotly(bar_plot)
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Reorder Rate by Hour (Scatterplot)

```{r}
reorder_by_hour = instacart_sample |>
  group_by(order_hour_of_day) |>
  summarize(reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE))

scatter_plot = reorder_by_hour |>
  ggplot(aes(x = order_hour_of_day, y = reorder_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Proportion Reordered"
  )

ggplotly(scatter_plot)
```

### Add-to-Cart Position by Department (Boxplot)

```{r}
box_plot = instacart_sample |>
  filter(department %in% c("produce", "dairy eggs", "snacks", "beverages")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = department, y = add_to_cart_order)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey80") +
  labs(
    x = "Department",
    y = "Position Added to Cart"
  )

ggplotly(box_plot)
```
